nodes.summary: Identifiability of the mixture proportion (our formulation): with the split points `A`, `B` given, two references `X₁`, `X₂` satisfying the hypotheses of `f2_admixedBranch` and with different contrasts `f2 A Xᵢ - f2 B Xᵢ` determine `α` from `f2` statistics.
nodes.title: Identifiability of the admixture proportion from f2 statistics

nodes.summary: The admixed-branch identity (Lipson et al. 2013): if `Mx` is an `α : 1 - α` mixture of the endpoints of the edges `a` (below `A`) and `b` (below `B`), followed by drift on `c`, and `A`, `B`, `X` do not use `a`, `b`, `c`, then `f2 Mx X = α f2 A X + (1 - α) f2 B X - α (1 - α) f2 A B + mixedDrift α ℓ_a ℓ_b ℓ_c`.
nodes.title: Admixed-branch identity for f2 statistics

nodes.summary: With binary loadings, `f3 O A B` is the total drift length of the edges shared by the paths `O–A` and `O–B` (on a tree, the path from `O` to the `A–B` path).
nodes.title: f3 statistic as shared drift on a tree

nodes.summary: For a fixed outgroup `O` and population `A`, the outgroup `f3` ranks candidates `B` by the drift they share with `A`.
nodes.title: Outgroup f3 ranks populations by shared drift

nodes.summary: Outgroup `f3` (Raghavan et al. 2014): with binary loadings, if the lineage of `O` shares no edge with the lineages of `A` and `B`, then `f3 O A B` is the drift from the outgroup to the root plus the drift shared by `A` and `B`.
nodes.title: Outgroup f3 statistic

nodes.summary: Given `α`, the mixed drift is determined by the `f2` statistics of one reference `X`.
nodes.title: Mixed drift determined by f2 statistics

nodes.summary: MixMapper's mixed drift `α² ℓ_a + (1 - α)² ℓ_b + ℓ_c`: the only combination of the terminal drift lengths that enters the `f2` statistics of an admixed population.
nodes.title: MixMapper mixed drift

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
